from transformers import AutoConfig
import json

models = {
    'Qwen3-1.7B-Base': '/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-1___7B-Base',
    'Qwen3-0.6B-Base': '/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-0___6B-Base',
    'pythia-2.8b': '/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-2.8b/AI-ModelScope/pythia-2___8b',
    'pythia-1b': '/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-1b/EleutherAI/pythia-1b',
    'OLMo-2-0425-1B': '/root/autodl-tmp/models/olmo-2-1b-hf/allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B',
}

for name, path in models.items():
    try:
        c = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(path, trust_remote_code=True)
        V = c.vocab_size
        H = c.hidden_size
        L = c.num_hidden_layers
        I = c.intermediate_size
        heads = c.num_attention_heads
        kv_heads = getattr(c, 'num_key_value_heads', heads)
        head_dim = getattr(c, 'head_dim', H // heads)
        tie = getattr(c, 'tie_word_embeddings', False)
        
        # Estimate params
        embed = V * H
        attn_per_layer = H * heads * head_dim + H * kv_heads * head_dim + H * heads * head_dim + heads * head_dim * H
        # simplified: Q + K + V + O projections
        # Q: H -> heads*head_dim, K: H -> kv_heads*head_dim, V: H -> kv_heads*head_dim, O: heads*head_dim -> H
        attn_per_layer = H * (heads * head_dim) + H * (kv_heads * head_dim) + H * (kv_heads * head_dim) + (heads * head_dim) * H
        ffn_per_layer = H * I * 2 + I * H  # gate + up + down for SiLU/SwiGLU; or 2*H*I for GELU
        if c.hidden_act in ['silu']:
            ffn_per_layer = H * I * 3  # gate_proj + up_proj + down_proj
        else:
            ffn_per_layer = H * I * 2  # dense_h_to_4h + dense_4h_to_h (gelu)
        
        total_transformer = L * (attn_per_layer + ffn_per_layer)
        total = embed + total_transformer
        if not tie:
            total += V * H  # lm_head
        
        print(f'{name}: hidden={H}, layers={L}, inter={I}, vocab={V}, kv_heads={kv_heads}, tie={tie}, est_params={total/1e9:.2f}B')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name}: FAIL - {e}')
"
